title: Lemma S: closed sets invariant under small affine maps along a subspace
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let S ⊆ ℝ^P be closed and let L ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace such that {x : y + λx ∈ S} = S whenever y ∈ L, 0 < λ < 1 and |y| ≤ 1 − λ. Then (i) y + λz ∈ S ⇔ z ∈ S for all y ∈ L, all λ > 0 and all z ∈ ℝ^P; and (ii) if S ≠ ∅ then L ⊆ S.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsClosed S → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam < 1 → ‖y‖ ≤ 1 - lam → (fun x => y + lam • x) ⁻¹' S = S) → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ z, y + lam • z ∈ S ↔ z ∈ S) ∧ (S.Nonempty → (L : Set (Euclid P)) ⊆ S)
